page.overview:
Who is Laokoön?

Laokoön was one of the Argonauts. The exact extent as towards what role Laokoön played in the Quest for the Golden Fleece since her only mention comes when the Argonauts assemble.

"Laocoön, son of Porthaon, brother of Oeneus, a Calydonian." Category:Argonauts
